title: Chiikawa Anime Film Opens at #1, 5th Live-Action Kingdom Film Drops to #3
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, opened on Friday and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action 'Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun' BL Series' Trailer Unveils More Cast, Opening Song
content: MBS presented a new trailer and visual for the live-action series of Amekiri 's Chotto Matō yo, Harutora-kun (Wait a second, Harutora-kun) boys-love manga on Thursday. title: Sins of Kujo Manga Gets Live-Action Film in 2027
content: TOHO Films announced in a teaser video on Thursday that Shohei Manabe 's Kujō no Taizai (Sins of Kujo) manga is inspiring a live-action film on January 8, 2027. The staff and other cast members from the live-action series are also returning for the film.
author: ANN

title: Takunomi's Haruto Hino Launches New Manga on August 30
content: Shogakukan 's Manga ONE service announced on Sunday that Haruto Hino will launch a new manga on the service titled Mizuki no Koibito (Mizuki's Lover) on August 30. The manga centers on two famous former child actors Mii-chan and Kei-kun becoming lovers.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer’s Next Anime Release Won’t Be Infinity Castle Part 2, But Something Else
content: After a little more than a year, Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle has finally arrived on the Crunchyroll streaming platform, setting a record that no one had hoped for. title: Ingoku Danchi Manga Ends on July 31
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Dragon Age magazine announced on Tuesday that writer Sakusei Kenkyūjo and artist Yui Jōyama 's Ingoku Danchi (Indecent Apartment Complex) manga will end on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Was a Major Inspiration Behind the Latest Game of the Year
content: Attack on Titan is undoubtedly one of the biggest anime series ever created, and it achieved that through its compelling elements. The series excels on many fronts, from its narrative and characters to even the intricate details of its character designs.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto The Card Game Reveals First Trailer
content: In the past, the anime world has been finding its way into some wild new media to gain more success. One of the biggest examples has been the likes of Dragon Ball, One Piece, Mobile Suit Gundam , and Godzilla receiving trading card games of their own.
author: ComicBook

title: Gabriel Dropout Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: The September issue of Kadokawa 's Dengeki Daioh G magazine announced on Sunday that Ukami 's Gabriel Dropout manga will end in its next chapter. Yen Press publishes the series in English and describes the story: A fallen angel with falling grades!
author: ANN
